newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-THURSDAY'S RESULTS FROM THE U.S. OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-THURSDAY'S RESULTS FROM THE U.S. OPEN.

text.p: Results from the U.S. Open tennis championships at the National Tennis Centre on Thursday (prefix number denotes seeding):
8-Jacco Eltingh and Paul Haarhuis (Netherlands) beat 4-Guy Forget (France) and Jakob Hlasek (Switzerland) 7-6 (7-5) 7-6 (10-8)
1-Todd Woodbridge and Mark Woodforde (Australia) beat Mark Philippoussis and Patrick Rafter (Australia) 6-7 (5-7) 6-3 6-4
3-Lisa Raymond and Patrick Galbraith (U.S.) beat 4-Manon Bollegraf (Netherlands) and Rick Leach (U.S.) 7-6 (8-6) 7-6 (7-4)
2-Gigi Fernandez (U.S.) and Natasha Zvereva (Belarus) beat 6-Lori McNeil (U.S.) and Gabriela Sabatini (Argentina) 6-2 7-6 (7-5)
1-Jana Novotna (Czech Republic) and Arantxa Sanchez Vicario (Spain) beat 4-Martina Hingis (Switzerland) and Helena Sukova (Czech Republic) 6-1 1-6 6-1
